hotels.title: Elegant Downtown Montreal City Break with Three Restaurants, Indoor Pool & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Soak up the vibrant energy of Downtown Montreal from this stylish hideaway, where mid-century glamour meets contemporary opulence. Unwind in style in the modern rooms and suites - some inspired by the city's trendy neighbourhoods - take a dip in the serene indoor pool and recharge with soothing treatments at the Moment Spa. Savour French-inspired cuisine at Roselys, sip artisanal cocktails at Bar Nacarat or grab a pick-me-up at the chic Cafe Krema. With direct access to Central Station and Montreal Underground City, you're perfectly placed to explore Crescent Street’s nightlife and the charm of Old Montreal. Whether you're chasing culture or cuisine, this refined retreat delivers it all.

hotels.title: Stylish Old Montreal City Escape with Onsite Restaurant & Absinthe Bar
hotels.description: Say bonjour to the perfect city break with a stay at InterContinental Montreal, an IHG Hotel masterfully positioned between Old Montreal’s historic basilicas and downtown’s world-class bars, bistros and high-end boutiques. Old-world hospitality abounds - swim laps at the hotel's top-notch saltwater pool, savour mouthwatering cuisine and imported French wines at Osco! or head to Sarah B. absinthe bar for cosy alcove ambience and an authentic taste of the good stuff.
